experiment: Xyce .NOISE across two nodes (the engine-facts owner, phase 2; re-measured 2026-10-17 on both launchers): V(OUT,0) on a flat divider, V(A,B) on a flat ladder, V(OUT,0) on a deck with a subckt and on e2e 25's Xyce noise deck; V(OUT) on the subckt deck; e2e 25's deck at XI2:MID with its 0 A input (5.6's vamos_nin1) in the divider body, named by its path, by its top-level name and bare; added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): .PRINT NOISE with VM(OUT) and VP(OUT)
result: `.NOISE V(a,b)`, even `V(OUT,0)`, aborts while parsing: "OUT OF MEMORY (error in 'new')", rc 1, on the flat decks and (2026-10-17, both launchers) on the decks with a subckt too, writing no print file; `.NOISE V(OUT)` runs; the input source in the subckt body runs under its path (XI2:IVAMOS_NIN1) and, 2026-10-17, also under its top-level name (IVAMOS_NIN1, VAMOS_NIN1), each with the same INOISE (ONOISE over 750 ohm squared). The row's segfaults (rc 139 or -11: the subckt deck with V(a,b), and the top-level name) did not reproduce on these decks. Added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): .PRINT NOISE accepts VM(OUT) and VP(OUT) beside ONOISE and INOISE (VM(OUT) = 0.5 on the divider)
